subtitle.en: Chapter I · Rain at Daze Village
subtitle.ja: 第一章 · 大沢郷の雨
subtitle.vi: Chương I · Mưa ở Đại Trạch

objective.en: Turn nine hundred isolated names into one political body without hiding the obligation created.
objective.ar: حوّل تسعمئة اسم منفصل إلى جسد سياسي واحد من دون إخفاء الالتزام الناشئ.
objective.de: Forme aus neunhundert vereinzelten Namen einen politischen Körper, ohne die entstehende Verpflichtung zu verschweigen.
objective.es: Convierte novecientos nombres aislados en un cuerpo político sin ocultar la obligación que nace.
objective.fr: Faire de neuf cents noms isolés un corps politique sans cacher l’obligation ainsi créée.
objective.ja: 九百の孤立した名を、生まれる責務を隠さず一つの政治的共同体へ変える。
objective.ko: 고립된 구백 개의 이름을, 생겨난 의무를 감추지 않고 하나의 정치 공동체로 바꾼다.
objective.ru: Превратить девятьсот разрозненных имён в единое политическое целое, не скрывая возникшего обязательства.
objective.vi: Biến chín trăm cái tên rời rạc thành một cộng đồng chính trị mà không che giấu nghĩa vụ vừa hình thành.
objective.zh-Hans: 让九百个孤立的名字成为一个政治共同体，同时不掩盖由此产生的义务。
objective.zh-Hant: 讓九百個孤立的名字成為一個政治共同體，同時不掩蓋由此產生的義務。

objective.en: Turn declared purpose into rules for grain, signals, and accountable witnesses.
objective.ar: حوّل الغاية المعلنة إلى قواعد للمؤن والإشارات والشهود المسؤولين.
objective.de: Übersetze den erklärten Zweck in Regeln für Getreide, Signale und verantwortliche Zeugen.
objective.es: Convierte el propósito declarado en reglas para el grano, las señales y los testigos responsables.
objective.fr: Transformer le but déclaré en règles pour le grain, les signaux et les témoins responsables.
objective.ja: 掲げた目的を、糧食・合図・責任ある証人の規則へ変える。
objective.ko: 선언한 목적을 식량, 신호, 책임지는 증인의 규칙으로 바꾼다.
objective.ru: Превратить провозглашённую цель в правила для зерна, сигналов и ответственных свидетелей.
objective.vi: Biến mục đích đã tuyên bố thành quy tắc cho lương thực, tín hiệu và những người làm chứng có trách nhiệm.
objective.zh-Hans: 把公开宣示的目的变成粮食、信号与责任见证的规则。
objective.zh-Hant: 把公開宣示的目的變成糧食、信號與責任見證的規則。

objective.en: Pay the promise’s cost, survive pursuit, and choose the network’s next shape.
objective.ar: ادفع كلفة الوعد، وانجُ من المطاردة، واختر الهيئة التالية للشبكة.
objective.de: Trage die Kosten des Versprechens, überstehe die Verfolgung und wähle die nächste Gestalt des Netzwerks.
objective.es: Paga el coste de la promesa, sobrevive a la persecución y elige la próxima forma de la red.
objective.fr: Payer le prix de la promesse, survivre à la poursuite et choisir la prochaine forme du réseau.
objective.ja: 約束の代価を払い、追跡を生き延び、次のネットワークの形を選ぶ。
objective.ko: 약속의 대가를 치르고 추격에서 살아남아 네트워크의 다음 형태를 선택한다.
objective.ru: Заплатить цену обещания, пережить преследование и выбрать следующую форму сети.
objective.vi: Trả giá cho lời hứa, sống sót qua cuộc truy đuổi và chọn hình thế tiếp theo của mạng lưới.
objective.zh-Hans: 支付承诺的代价，在追击中存续，并选择网络的下一种形态。
objective.zh-Hant: 支付承諾的代價，在追擊中存續，並選擇網絡的下一種形態。

promise.en: Every name read into the covenant will cross as a person, not be discarded as anonymous freight.
promise.zh-Hans: 每个被读入盟约的名字，都要作为人过河，而不是作为无名负担被丢下。
promise.zh-Hant: 每個被讀入盟約的名字，都要作為人過河，而不是作為無名負擔被丟下。

forecast.en: Households cross before carts. The covenant's named protection is kept.
forecast.zh-Hans: 家户先于车辆过河。盟约对有名之人的保护得到兑现。
forecast.zh-Hant: 家戶先於車輛過河。盟約對有名之人的保護得到兌現。

response.en: Aunt Yu counts the last household onto the far bank before she nods to the rear guard.
response.zh-Hans: 妪母数着最后一户登上对岸，才向后卫点头。
response.zh-Hant: 嫗母數著最後一戶登上對岸，才向後衛點頭。

forecast.en: Bracing the ford protects the column, but named households wait in the pursuing rain.
forecast.zh-Hans: 加固渡口能保全队伍，有名在册的家户却要在追兵迫近的雨里等待。
forecast.zh-Hant: 加固渡口能保全隊伍，有名在冊的家戶卻要在追兵迫近的雨裡等待。

response.en: The braces hold. Aunt Yu accepts the passage, not the delay imposed on those promised protection first.
response.zh-Hans: 支架撑住了。妪母接受这条生路，却不接受让先受保护者久候。
response.zh-Hant: 支架撐住了。嫗母接受這條生路，卻不接受讓先受保護者久候。

forecast.en: Abandoning the loads leaves named households to recover what the movement will not carry.
forecast.zh-Hans: 弃下车辆，会让有名在册的家户折返去取队伍不再承担的物资。
forecast.zh-Hant: 棄下車輛，會讓有名在冊的家戶折返去取隊伍不再承擔的物資。

response.en: Aunt Yu sees families turn back toward the carts. Their names remain in the covenant; its protection does not.
response.zh-Hans: 妪母看着家户转身寻找车辆。名字仍在盟约里，保护却已不在。
response.zh-Hant: 嫗母看著家戶轉身尋找車輛。名字仍在盟約裡，保護卻已不在。

promise.en: The seized beacon will become movement before the relay network can take back the initiative.
promise.zh-Hans: 夺下的烽燧必须化为行动，不能让亭驿传信网夺回先手。
promise.zh-Hant: 奪下的烽燧必須化為行動，不能讓亭驛傳信網奪回先手。

forecast.en: Protecting households slows the seized tempo but makes the delay publicly defensible.
forecast.zh-Hans: 保护家户会放慢抢来的节奏，却能让延误有公开可辩的理由。
forecast.zh-Hant: 保護家戶會放慢搶來的節奏，卻能讓延誤有公開可辯的理由。

response.en: Wu Guang watches the rear guard wait. The movement loses time, but not the reason people gave it time.
response.zh-Hans: 吴广看着后卫停步。队伍失去了时间，却没有失去众人愿意给它时间的理由。
response.zh-Hant: 吳廣看著後衛停步。隊伍失去了時間，卻沒有失去眾人願意給它時間的理由。

forecast.en: Stationary labor at the ford returns initiative to the relay posts.
forecast.zh-Hans: 在渡口停留劳作，会把先手还给亭驿。
forecast.zh-Hant: 在渡口停留勞作，會把先手還給亭驛。

response.en: The repair saves provisions, but the captured signal becomes yesterday's fact while patrol reports catch up.
response.zh-Hans: 修渡保住了物资，夺烽却在巡报追上时变成了昨日的既成事实。
response.zh-Hant: 修渡保住了物資，奪烽卻在巡報追上時變成了昨日的既成事實。

forecast.en: Cutting the carts turns the stolen signal into immediate movement.
forecast.zh-Hans: 弃车疾进，会把夺来的信号立即化为行动。
forecast.zh-Hant: 棄車疾進，會把奪來的信號立即化為行動。

response.en: Wu Guang beats the captured rhythm once. The column is already moving when the echo reaches the posts.
response.zh-Hans: 吴广只击了一次夺来的节拍。回声传到亭驿时，队伍已经在路上。
response.zh-Hant: 吳廣只擊了一次奪來的節拍。回聲傳到亭驛時，隊伍已經在路上。

promise.en: No official channel will receive a trace it can join back to the hidden register.
promise.zh-Hans: 不能让任何官府渠道得到一条能接回被藏名籍的踪迹。
promise.zh-Hant: 不能讓任何官府渠道得到一條能接回被藏名籍的蹤跡。

forecast.en: A visible household procession protects people but gives witnesses one route to describe.
forecast.zh-Hans: 让家户列队过河能保护众人，也会给见证者留下一条可描述的路线。
forecast.zh-Hant: 讓家戶列隊過河能保護眾人，也會給見證者留下一條可描述的路線。

response.en: Courier Han cannot recover the names, but he can describe the order in which their households crossed.
response.zh-Hans: 韩驿使无法找回名字，却能描述这些名字所属家户过河的次序。
response.zh-Hant: 韓驛使無法找回名字，卻能描述這些名字所屬家戶過河的次序。

forecast.en: Cut timbers and wet grain leave a trace the relay can join to the missing list.
forecast.zh-Hans: 新砍木料与湿粮会留下一条亭驿能够接回失踪名籍的踪迹。
forecast.zh-Hant: 新砍木料與濕糧會留下一條亭驛能夠接回失蹤名籍的蹤跡。

response.en: Courier Han reads the repair like an entry in a ledger: materials, direction, numbers, time.
response.zh-Hans: 韩驿使像读名籍一样读懂修渡痕迹：材料、方向、人数、时辰。
response.zh-Hant: 韓驛使像讀名籍一樣讀懂修渡痕跡：材料、方向、人數、時辰。

forecast.en: Scattered tracks deny the relay one continuous route, even as the column loses supplies.
forecast.zh-Hans: 散开的车辙让亭驿无法拼出一条连续路线，队伍却要损失物资。
forecast.zh-Hant: 散開的車轍讓亭驛無法拼出一條連續路線，隊伍卻要損失物資。

response.en: Courier Han finds three false trails and no continuous column. The hidden register remains unjoined to the road.
response.zh-Hans: 韩驿使找到三条假迹，却找不到一支连续的队伍。被藏名籍仍无法与道路接合。
response.zh-Hant: 韓驛使找到三條假跡，卻找不到一支連續的隊伍。被藏名籍仍無法與道路接合。

description.en: A systemic reconstruction of how relay posts, witnesses and patrols may turn exposure into coordinated pursuit. It is not a claim about one documented patrol route.
description.zh-Hans: 对亭驿、见证人与巡卒如何把暴露转化为协同追捕的系统性重构；它不声称存在一条有史料记载的具体巡逻路线。
description.zh-Hant: 對亭驛、見證人與巡卒如何把暴露轉化為協同追捕的系統性重構；它不聲稱存在一條有史料記載的具體巡邏路線。

reading.en: Build power through names, public restraint and witnessed obligation.
reading.zh-Hans: 以名字、公开克制与共同见证的义务组织力量。
reading.zh-Hant: 以名字、公開克制與共同見證的義務組織力量。

reading.en: Create a fact through signals, direct command, speed or abandonment.
reading.zh-Hans: 以信号、直接号令、速度或弃物制造既成事实。
reading.zh-Hant: 以信號、直接號令、速度或棄物製造既成事實。

reading.en: Divide information, routes, provisions or authority across smaller channels.
reading.zh-Hans: 把消息、路线、补给或权力分散到较小的渠道。
reading.zh-Hant: 把消息、路線、補給或權力分散到較小的渠道。

description.en: A disclosed reconstruction of how repeated methods may let posts prepare one answer. It is not an attested Qin threat assessment.
description.zh-Hans: 对重复手法如何让亭驿预备一种应手的公开重构；它不是传世的秦吏威胁评估。
description.zh-Hant: 對重複手法如何讓亭驛預備一種應手的公開重構；它不是傳世的秦吏威脅評估。

forecast.en: The reports do not yet support one prepared countermeasure. Every method receives no added modifier.
forecast.zh-Hans: 现有报告尚不足以形成一种预备反制；所有手法均不追加修正。
forecast.zh-Hant: 現有報告尚不足以形成一種預備反制；所有手法均不追加修正。

response.en: Contradictory reports fail to anticipate this method.
response.zh-Hans: 彼此矛盾的报告未能预判这次手法。
response.zh-Hant: 彼此矛盾的報告未能預判這次手法。

counterplay.en: Keep method counts tied, or change method before one pattern hardens.
counterplay.zh-Hans: 维持手法次数相同，或在单一模式固化前改变手法。
counterplay.zh-Hant: 維持手法次數相同，或在單一模式固化前改變手法。

forecast.en: Posts are comparing names and public obligations. Another Witnessed compact receives +3 Exposure; another method makes this read miss.
forecast.zh-Hans: 各亭正在核对名字与公开义务。再次采用见证盟约将追加+3险；改用其他手法则使判断落空。
forecast.zh-Hant: 各亭正在核對名字與公開義務。再次採用見證盟約將追加+3險；改用其他手法則使判斷落空。

hitResponse.en: Repeated public commitments let clerks connect names into one trace.
hitResponse.zh-Hans: 重复的公开承诺让亭吏把名字串成了一条踪迹。
hitResponse.zh-Hant: 重複的公開承諾讓亭吏把名字串成了一條蹤跡。

missResponse.en: The changed method leaves the prepared witness chain without a useful match.
missResponse.zh-Hans: 手法改变，预备好的证词串联没有找到可用的对应。
missResponse.zh-Hant: 手法改變，預備好的證詞串聯沒有找到可用的對應。

counterplay.en: Choose Forced tempo or Distributed cover; a tie in method counts dissolves this read.
counterplay.zh-Hans: 改用强夺先手或分散掩护；手法次数持平即可解除本次识势。
counterplay.zh-Hant: 改用強奪先手或分散掩護；手法次數持平即可解除本次識勢。

forecast.en: Neighboring posts expect another direct signal or rush. Another Forced tempo receives +1 Exposure and −3 Momentum; another method makes this read miss.
forecast.zh-Hans: 邻亭预期再次出现直接信号或疾进。再次强夺先手将追加+1险、−3势；改用其他手法则使判断落空。
forecast.zh-Hant: 鄰亭預期再次出現直接信號或疾進。再次強奪先手將追加+1險、−3勢；改用其他手法則使判斷落空。

hitResponse.en: Prepared posts interrupt the expected direction before it can become a new fact.
hitResponse.zh-Hans: 有所准备的亭驿截住了预期方向，使其未能立刻成为新的事实。
hitResponse.zh-Hant: 有所準備的亭驛截住了預期方向，使其未能立刻成為新的事實。

missResponse.en: The changed method leaves the prepared relay block facing the wrong tempo.
missResponse.zh-Hans: 手法改变，预备好的截断面对了错误的节奏。
missResponse.zh-Hant: 手法改變，預備好的截斷面對了錯誤的節奏。

counterplay.en: Choose Witnessed compact or Distributed cover; a tie in method counts dissolves this read.
counterplay.zh-Hans: 改用见证盟约或分散掩护；手法次数持平即可解除本次识势。
counterplay.zh-Hant: 改用見證盟約或分散掩護；手法次數持平即可解除本次識勢。

forecast.en: Patrols are pressing several small routes and stores. Another Distributed cover receives +2 Exposure and −2 Grain; another method makes this read miss.
forecast.zh-Hans: 巡卒正在挤压多条支路与小型储备。再次分散掩护将追加+2险、−2粮；改用其他手法则使判断落空。
forecast.zh-Hant: 巡卒正在擠壓多條支路與小型儲備。再次分散掩護將追加+2險、−2糧；改用其他手法則使判斷落空。

hitResponse.en: Pressure across several small channels forces detours and consumes reserve.
hitResponse.zh-Hans: 多条小渠道同时受压，队伍被迫绕行并消耗储备。
hitResponse.zh-Hant: 多條小渠道同時受壓，隊伍被迫繞行並消耗儲備。

missResponse.en: The changed method concentrates elsewhere, beyond the prepared channel squeeze.
missResponse.zh-Hans: 手法改变，力量转向预备挤压之外的方向。
missResponse.zh-Hant: 手法改變，力量轉向預備擠壓之外的方向。

counterplay.en: Choose Witnessed compact or Forced tempo; a tie in method counts dissolves this read.
counterplay.zh-Hans: 改用见证盟约或强夺先手；手法次数持平即可解除本次识势。
counterplay.zh-Hant: 改用見證盟約或強奪先手；手法次數持平即可解除本次識勢。

forecast.en: Posts hold incomplete reports. This decision receives no added pursuit modifier.
forecast.zh-Hans: 各亭只握有零散消息。本次决策不追加追捕修正。
forecast.zh-Hant: 各亭只握有零散消息。本次決策不追加追捕修正。

response.en: The posts fail to coordinate before the order clears their view.
response.zh-Hans: 各亭未能在命令脱离视野前完成协同。
response.zh-Hant: 各亭未能在命令脫離視野前完成協同。

counterplay.en: Keep Exposure below 55 to prevent a coordinated road search.
counterplay.zh-Hans: 把险维持在55以下，阻止各亭形成道路搜捕。
counterplay.zh-Hant: 把險維持在55以下，阻止各亭形成道路搜捕。

forecast.en: Relay reports are being compared. This decision receives +2 Exposure after its authored response.
forecast.zh-Hans: 亭驿正在核对消息。本次决策在既定应手后追加+2险。
forecast.zh-Hant: 亭驛正在核對消息。本次決策在既定應手後追加+2險。

response.en: Cross-checked reports narrow the road behind the column.
response.zh-Hans: 相互核对的报告缩窄了队伍身后的道路。
response.zh-Hant: 相互核對的報告縮窄了隊伍身後的道路。

counterplay.en: Reduce Exposure below 55 to break coordination before the next order.
counterplay.zh-Hans: 在下一道命令前把险降到55以下，打断协同。
counterplay.zh-Hant: 在下一道命令前把險降到55以下，打斷協同。

forecast.en: Patrols now share witnesses and supplies. This decision receives +4 Exposure and −1 Grain after its authored response.
forecast.zh-Hans: 巡卒已共享证人与补给。本次决策在既定应手后追加+4险、−1粮。
forecast.zh-Hant: 巡卒已共享證人與補給。本次決策在既定應手後追加+4險、−1糧。

response.en: Mounted patrols close another road and consume the column's remaining margin.
response.zh-Hans: 骑卒又封住一条道路，并消耗队伍仅剩的余地。
response.zh-Hant: 騎卒又封住一條道路，並消耗隊伍僅剩的餘地。

counterplay.en: Reduce Exposure below 75 before the next order to break the cordon.
counterplay.zh-Hans: 在下一道命令前把险降到75以下，撕开合围。
counterplay.zh-Hant: 在下一道命令前把險降到75以下，撕開合圍。

summary.en: Current operational ground. The received accounts place the delayed conscripts and uprising at Daze; the exact administrative geography remains under specialist review.
summary.zh-Hans: 当前行动地点。传世记载把戍卒受阻与起事置于大泽乡；其确切行政地理仍待专家审阅。

uncertainty.en: The marker, river and roads are schematic. They do not assert coordinates, distance, route or scale.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 地点标记、河道与道路均为示意，不声称对应坐标、距离、路线或尺度。

summary.en: A known campaign marker that becomes the next playable ground. Its relation to Daze is presented as a strategic diagram, not measured travel.
summary.zh-Hans: 一个已知的战役标记，也是接下来的可玩地点。它与大泽乡的关系只是战略示意，不是测定行程。

uncertainty.en: Route, distance, administrative extent and travel time are intentionally unstated pending historical-GIS review.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 路线、距离、行政范围与行程时间均不作断言，等待历史地理审阅。

summary.en: A distant network reported after Daze. Its later association with Liu Bang is not knowledge available to the opening council.
summary.zh-Hans: 大泽乡起事后才进入消息网络的远方力量。它后来与刘邦的关系并非开局议事者能够预知。

uncertainty.en: The report is a horizon of possibility, not a selectable destination or promise of Liu Bang's later victory.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 这条消息只代表一种可能性边界，不是可选目的地，也不预示刘邦后来的胜利。

summary.en: A distant rising reported after Daze. Xiang Yu's later role is not knowledge available to the opening council.
summary.zh-Hans: 大泽乡起事后才传来的远方起兵消息。项羽后来的地位并非开局议事者能够预知。

uncertainty.en: The marker preserves an uncertain political horizon; it is not a route, scale claim or predetermined Xiang path.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 该标记只保留不确定的政治远景，不表示路线、尺度或预定的项氏道路。

summary.en: A state-center reference marker outside the current playable horizon. No Chapter I route or destination is attached to it.
summary.zh-Hans: 当前可玩范围之外的国家中心参照标记。第一章没有赋予它路线或目的地功能。

uncertainty.en: Its placement supplies orientation only and makes no claim about scale, travel or operational reach.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 其位置只用于方向参照，不声称对应尺度、行程或行动范围。

role.zh-Hans: 虚构的戍卒名籍吏，也是玩家
role.zh-Hant: 虛構的戍卒名籍吏，也是玩家

role.en: A fictional village cook and head of a displaced household
role.zh-Hans: 虚构的乡厨与流离家户之长
role.zh-Hant: 虛構的鄉廚與流離家戶之長

sources.work: 孙子兵法 / The Art of War
sources.locator: 始計第一 · 五事（道、天、地、將、法）
sources.date: received text, Warring States strata debated

note.en: A design lens for explaining strategic alignment, season, terrain, command, and organization. It does not document this episode.
note.zh-Hans: 作为解释人心、天时、地利、将领与组织的设计视角；并非本事件的史料。

sources.section: The Keeper, Aunt Yu, Courier Han, council details and all player choices

note.en: Fiction constructed to let the player reason within historical constraints. It is explicitly separated from attested persons and events.
note.zh-Hans: 为让玩家在历史约束中推演而创作的虚构内容，与传世记载中的人物事件明确区分。

statement.en: The received Shiji, Hanshu, and Zizhi Tongjian traditions place Chen Sheng and Wu Guang's uprising in Qin Ershi's first year, seventh month; SHI renders the conventional date as 209 BCE.
statement.zh-Hans: 《史记》《汉书》《资治通鉴》的传世叙事都把陈胜、吴广起事系于秦二世元年七月；《势》按通行纪年标作公元前209年。

uncertainty.en: The calendrical conversion and exact day are not asserted; the interface gives a month-level dramatic date.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 游戏不主张精确到日，也不把历法换算写成无争议事实；界面只采用月份层级的戏剧时间。

gameUse.en: Dates the opening and prevents later Chu-Han events from leaking backward into the scene.
gameUse.zh-Hans: 限定开场时间，避免把后来的楚汉事件倒灌进大泽乡。

statement.en: The received accounts describe nine hundred conscripts or levy laborers bound for Yuyang and gathered at Daze Village.
statement.zh-Hans: 传世叙事称九百名戍卒或被征发者前往渔阳，并屯于大泽乡。

uncertainty.en: The number and administrative composition come from related received narratives, not a surviving Qin roster.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 人数与编组来自彼此相关的传世叙事，并非现存秦代名籍。

gameUse.en: Sets the scale of the stranded column; the player character's register remains fictional.
gameUse.zh-Hans: 确定受困队伍的大致规模；玩家掌管的名籍仍属虚构。

statement.en: The received accounts connect heavy rain, an impassable road, and an expected missed deadline at Daze.
statement.zh-Hans: 传世叙事把大雨、道路不通与预计失期连在一起。

uncertainty.en: No surviving weather log proves the storm's exact duration, water level, or route effects.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 没有现存气象记录能证实雨期、水位或道路影响的具体程度。

gameUse.en: Creates the opening logistical crisis; exact flood imagery is reconstruction.
gameUse.zh-Hans: 构成开场的后勤危机；具体积水景象属于重构。

statement.en: The received narratives state that missing the deadline carried a death penalty; whether this accurately reflects Qin statutes and enforcement is unresolved.
statement.zh-Hans: 传世叙事称失期当斩；这一说法是否准确对应秦律条文及实际执行，尚未解决。

uncertainty.en: This P0 claim requires comparison with excavated Qin legal texts and a legal historian before public alpha wording can be approved.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 这项P0主张必须与出土秦律材料对读，并经秦汉法律史专家审阅后，方可批准公测措辞。

gameUse.en: The opening says the received histories report death and explicitly notes that uniform application remains debated.
gameUse.zh-Hans: 开场只说传世史书称其为死罪，并明确提示是否一律执行仍有争议。

statement.en: The received accounts identify Chen Sheng and Wu Guang as tunzhang among the assembled conscripts.
statement.zh-Hans: 传世叙事称陈胜、吴广在戍卒中担任屯长。

uncertainty.en: The exact duties and command relationship represented by this title still require terminological review.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 屯长的具体职责与指挥关系仍需制度史和术语审校。

gameUse.en: Supports showing both men as organizers without making the player their commander.
gameUse.zh-Hans: 支持把二人写成组织者，同时避免让玩家凌驾于其上。

statement.en: The received and annotated traditions associate Daze Village with Qi county in the Pei commandery region.
statement.zh-Hans: 传世文本及其注家把大泽乡与沛郡蕲县一带联系起来。

uncertainty.en: Administrative boundaries, modern site identification, travel distance, and the schematic map all require historical-GIS review.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 政区沿革、今址对应、行程距离与游戏示意地图均需历史地理审阅。

gameUse.en: Names the opening site while keeping all map coordinates explicitly schematic.
gameUse.zh-Hans: 为开场地点命名，同时明确所有地图坐标仅作示意。

statement.en: Later narratives place the Pei uprising response after news of Chen Sheng's rising, not as a force already known at the Daze decision.
statement.zh-Hans: 后世叙事把沛县响应置于陈胜起事消息传开之后，而不是大泽乡决策时已经明朗的力量。

uncertainty.en: Sequence is used at month-level only; speeches, omens, and later imperial destiny are not treated as transparent facts.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 这里只采用月份层级的先后关系；言辞、祥异与后来的帝王命运不作透明事实。

gameUse.en: Allows Pei to appear only as an uncertain future network in the ending.
gameUse.zh-Hans: 只允许沛县在结尾作为尚不确定的未来网络进入视野。

statement.en: Later narratives place the Xiang clan's Kuaiji rising after Chen Sheng's uprising became known.
statement.zh-Hans: 后世叙事把项氏在会稽起兵置于陈胜起事消息传开之后。

uncertainty.en: The game does not carry later heroic characterization or foreknowledge of Xiang Yu into Daze.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 游戏不把后来的英雄化书写或对项羽命运的预知带回大泽乡。

gameUse.en: Allows Kuaiji to appear as a distant emerging force rather than a predetermined route.
gameUse.zh-Hans: 让会稽只作为远方正在形成的力量出现，而非预定路线。

statement.en: The received Sunzi opening organizes strategic comparison through alignment, season, terrain, command, and organization.
statement.zh-Hans: 传世《孙子》首篇以道、天、地、将、法组织战略比较。

uncertainty.en: This is a design lens only; it is not evidence that any Daze participant applied a named Sunzi doctrine.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 这只是设计视角，不能证明大泽乡任何人物曾按《孙子》学说行事。

gameUse.en: Shapes the five-resource field and Go-like positional explanations.
gameUse.zh-Hans: 用于塑造五种资源与围棋式的形势解读。

statement.en: The Keeper, Aunt Yu, Courier Han, their dialogue, the councils, and every player choice are original dramatic reconstruction.
statement.zh-Hans: 掌简人、妪母、韩驿使、他们的对白、议事场景与全部玩家选择均为原创戏剧性重构。

uncertainty.en: No invented line is presented as a historical quotation.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 任何虚构台词都不冒充历史引文。

gameUse.en: Creates playable deliberation while keeping the fiction boundary inspectable.
gameUse.zh-Hans: 在保持虚构边界可查的前提下形成可玩的议事过程。

statement.en: The campaign map is a strategic diagram; its coordinates, river curve, and travel spacing are not geographic measurement.
statement.zh-Hans: 战役地图是战略示意图；坐标、河道曲线与地点间距都不是地理测量。

uncertainty.en: Historical-GIS work remains a P0 gate before the map can imply routes or scale.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 地图若要表达路线或尺度，必须先通过P0历史地理审阅。

gameUse.en: Prevents players from reading the wartable as a measured historical map.
gameUse.zh-Hans: 避免玩家把沙盘误读为经过测绘的历史地图。

claims.reviewer: SHI art and history teams · schematic boundary

statement.en: All seed-selected rain, road, rumor, supply, and observation conditions are authored gameplay circumstances, not claims about a recorded occurrence.
statement.zh-Hans: 所有由种子选出的雨势、道路、传言、补给与观察条件都是原创玩法情境，不声称对应某次有记录的具体事件。

uncertainty.en: Their plausibility still requires environmental and material-culture review before alpha.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 这些情境的合理性仍需在公测前接受环境史与物质文化审阅。

gameUse.en: Adds fair replay variation while visibly separating possibility from attested history.
gameUse.zh-Hans: 在明确区分可能性与传世记载的同时，提供公平的重复游玩变化。

statement.en: Chapter I characters do not know the later victories, offices, or reputations of Liu Bang and Xiang Yu.
statement.zh-Hans: 第一章人物不知道刘邦、项羽后来的胜负、官号或名声。

uncertainty.en: This is a narrative anti-hindsight rule, not a source claim about private knowledge.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 这是防止后见之明的叙事规则，并非关于人物私下认知的史料主张。

gameUse.en: Keeps Pei and Kuaiji uncertain and prevents destiny-driven choice design.
gameUse.zh-Hans: 让沛与会稽保持不确定，避免用宿命论设计选择。

title.en: The road has become a river

context.en: Nine hundred conscripts are stalled in a storm. The northern garrison deadline is passing. The received histories say the penalty was death; how uniformly such law was applied remains debated. In this reconstruction, you hold the soaked register that makes the crowd legible to the state.
context.zh-Hans: 九百戍卒被暴雨阻在大泽乡，赴渔阳的期限正在逾越。传世记载称“失期，法皆斩”，其法律是否一概如此执行仍有争论。在本作的重构中，你掌握着湿透的名籍——它让众人在国家眼中可被计算。

dialogue.en: “If the register reaches the next post, we are nine hundred isolated offenders. If it does not, what are we?” Chen Sheng does not raise his voice. Rain answers for him on the roof tiles.
dialogue.zh-Hans: “名籍若送到下一亭，我们便是九百个各自待罪的人。名籍若送不到——我们又是什么？”陈胜没有高声。雨点替他敲着屋瓦。

signal.en: The drainage ditch has joined the road. Whichever order is given, the column will spend food and reveal fresh tracks getting into motion.
signal.zh-Hans: 排水沟已经漫成道路。无论下达哪道命令，队伍起行都要耗粮，也会留下更清楚的新辙。

title.en: The rain breaks to the east

signal.en: Voices and footfalls carry again. Any order can move faster, while the fading rain gives patrols less cover.
signal.zh-Hans: 人声与脚步重新传得开。任何命令都能更快落实，渐歇的雨也让巡卒少了遮蔽。

intent.en: Turn a transport list into a public covenant.
intent.zh-Hans: 把押运名籍变成众人共同的盟约。

consequence.en: The ranks see one another, but the officers now know where solidarity began.
consequence.zh-Hans: 戍卒开始彼此看见，但军吏也知道团结从何处发生。

strategy.en: Broad position: invest in legitimacy before speed.
strategy.zh-Hans: 厚势：先积合法性，再求速度。

warning.en: A public covenant also gives officials names and witnesses.
warning.zh-Hans: 公开盟约也会给军吏留下名字和证人。

reveal.en: Before dawn, a relay clerk copies the names of three speakers. Solidarity has acquired a trace.
reveal.zh-Hans: 黎明前，一名亭吏抄走了三位发言者的名字。团结从此也留下了踪迹。

intent.en: Control the signal network before the story outruns you.
intent.zh-Hans: 在消息失控前先控制传信网络。

consequence.en: Weapons and urgency enter the camp together.
consequence.zh-Hans: 兵刃与紧迫感同时进入营地。

strategy.en: Forcing move: gain initiative while accepting exposure.
strategy.zh-Hans: 先手：以暴露风险换取主动。

warning.en: A broken beacon forces neighboring posts to redirect patrols.
warning.zh-Hans: 烽燧断绝会迫使邻亭改派巡卒。

reveal.en: Two neighboring posts miss the signal and send mounted scouts toward the road. The seizure buys initiative, not invisibility.
reveal.zh-Hans: 两处邻亭等不到信号，遂遣骑卒沿路搜寻。夺燧换来了先手，却没有换来隐身。

label.en: Hide the register; watch one night

intent.en: Make room for information before commitment.
intent.zh-Hans: 在下注前先争取情报空间。

consequence.en: You learn who moves between tents, but hesitation costs food and confidence.
consequence.zh-Hans: 你看清了营帐间的往来，但迟疑消耗粮食与信心。

strategy.en: Probe: preserve options and conceal intent.
strategy.zh-Hans: 试应手：保留选择，隐藏意图。

warning.en: Delay consumes provisions while the missing list becomes suspicious.
warning.zh-Hans: 拖延会消耗口粮，而名籍失踪本身也会引起怀疑。

reveal.en: A second meal passes in the rain. No order arrives, but uncertainty begins to command the camp in its place.
reveal.zh-Hans: 雨中又吃掉一顿口粮。命令没有到来，不确定却开始替命令支配营地。

context.en: Public trust has given the camp a voice. It has not given it supplies. Villagers have hidden grain from tax collectors and bandits alike.
context.zh-Hans: 公开结盟让营地有了共同声音，却没有凭空生出粮食。乡民把存粮藏着，既防税吏，也防盗寇。

dialogue.en: Aunt Yu puts an empty scoop beside your register. “A just cause can still empty an unjustly full granary. Tell us the rule before hunger writes it for you.”
dialogue.zh-Hans: 妪母把一只空斗放在名籍旁：“义军也能掏空一座不义的粮仓。趁饥饿还没替你定规矩，先把规矩说清楚。”

signal.en: Households have moved their stores behind timber. Every plan consumes extra grain while the camp proves what kind of guest it will be.
signal.zh-Hans: 各户已把存粮移到木门之后。营地尚未证明自己是哪一种来客，任何方案都会多耗粮食。

signal.en: Several households wait where the council can see them. Any order will gain witnesses and helping hands, but feeding the gathering still costs grain.
signal.zh-Hans: 几户人家站在议事处看得见的地方等候。任何命令都会多出见证者和帮手，聚众吃饭仍要耗粮。

intent.en: Requisition now, bind repayment to the movement's reputation.
intent.zh-Hans: 先行征粮，把日后偿还系于军队声誉。

consequence.en: Some stores open. Your promise becomes a debt future commanders can honor—or betray.
consequence.zh-Hans: 一些粮窖打开了。你的承诺成为后继者可以兑现、也可以背弃的债。

strategy.en: Create an institution where force alone would be cheaper today.
strategy.zh-Hans: 制度之势：在暴力眼下更便宜时，仍建立可延续的信用。

warning.en: A promise must be witnessed; verification slows departure.
warning.zh-Hans: 承诺必须有人见证，而核验会拖慢出发。

reveal.en: Two granaries open only after village elders mark each tally. The promise gains weight while the road gains distance.
reveal.zh-Hans: 两处粮窖直到乡老逐券作记才肯开启。承诺有了分量，道路也因此拉长。

label.en: Ask each fire for one pot

intent.en: Distribute sacrifice visibly and cap what can be taken.

consequence.en: The camp moves leaner, but households join because the boundary feels real.
consequence.zh-Hans: 队伍更加拮据，却有家户因看见界线而愿意同行。

strategy.en: Thick position: fewer supplies, stronger consent.
strategy.zh-Hans: 厚势：少取物资，多积人心。

warning.en: A capped levy protects consent but leaves almost no reserve.
warning.zh-Hans: 定额征粮守住了同意，却几乎留不下余粮。

reveal.en: Every fire gives what was promised and no more. The boundary is credible; so is the column's hunger.
reveal.zh-Hans: 每处灶火都只献出约定的一釜，绝不多给。界线因此可信，队伍的饥饿也同样真实。

dateLabel.zh-Hans: 秦二世元年 · 黎明前

title.en: The beacon is now an accusation

context.en: The relay guards have been disarmed. Nearby posts will see the missing signal at dawn. Momentum is high; recognition is not the same as allegiance.
context.zh-Hans: 亭卒已被缴械。天亮后，邻亭就会察觉烽燧断绝。声势骤起，但被人看见不等于被人拥护。

dialogue.en: Wu Guang turns the captured drum on its side. “A drum tells everyone to move. It does not tell them why they should follow us after the first mile.”
dialogue.zh-Hans: 吴广把缴来的鼓侧放在地上：“鼓能叫所有人动起来，却不能告诉他们，为何走过第一里后还要跟着我们。”

signal.en: The dead beacon's smoke lies along the road instead of rising. Whatever follows will be easier for nearby posts to trace and harder for strangers to trust.
signal.zh-Hans: 熄灭烽燧的烟没有升起，反而贴着道路铺开。接下来的行动更容易被邻亭追出，也更难让陌生人信服。

signal.en: Thunder masks the first movement from neighboring posts. Any order gains tempo before the road can answer.
signal.zh-Hans: 雷声遮住了最初的动静。无论下达哪道命令，都能在驿道作出反应前抢到一点时间。

label.en: Raise the memory of Great Chu

intent.en: Use a shared political memory to turn shock into direction.
intent.zh-Hans: 以共同的政治记忆，把震动变成方向。

consequence.en: The cry travels faster than your ability to define it.
consequence.zh-Hans: 口号传播得比你解释它的能力更快。

strategy.en: Narrative initiative: powerful, difficult to retrieve.
strategy.zh-Hans: 叙事先手：力量巨大，也难以收回。

warning.en: The banner will be repeated by mouths you cannot command.
warning.zh-Hans: 旗号会被你无法号令的人反复传说。

reveal.en: By sunrise, three incompatible versions of “Great Chu” are moving along the road. The cry recruits and exposes at once.
reveal.zh-Hans: 日出时，道路上已流传着三种彼此冲突的“大楚”。呼声一面聚众，一面暴露。

label.en: Extinguish the tower; move in silence

intent.en: Trade spectacle for one more unobserved march.
intent.zh-Hans: 舍弃声势，换取一次不被观察的行军。

consequence.en: You regain time, but some mistake discipline for fear.
consequence.zh-Hans: 你们赢回了时间，也有人把克制误作胆怯。

strategy.en: Tempo control: refuse the opponent's clock.
strategy.zh-Hans: 控速：拒绝按对手的时钟行动。

warning.en: Silence protects the route but turns mud and hunger into command problems.
warning.zh-Hans: 沉默能遮蔽路线，却会让泥泞与饥饿变成号令难题。

reveal.en: Without drums or lamps, the rear loses the path twice. The march stays hidden by spending food and human strength.
reveal.zh-Hans: 没有鼓声与灯火，后队两次走失。行军靠消耗粮食与人力才保持隐蔽。

context.en: Your watch catches a relay courier searching for the register. He is frightened, observant, and useful. Every way of containing knowledge creates a witness.
context.zh-Hans: 守夜者抓到一名寻找名籍的驿使。他害怕、敏锐，也可能有用。每一种封锁消息的方法，都会制造一个见证人。

dialogue.en: Courier Han looks at the blank space where the register was. “A missing list is already a message. Let me choose who receives it.”
dialogue.zh-Hans: 韩驿使看着名籍原先摆放的空处：“名籍失踪，本身就是一封信。让我选它送到谁手里。”

signal.en: Another relay horse passed recently. Any decision now enters a network already moving faster than the camp.
signal.zh-Hans: 不久前还有另一匹驿马经过。此刻的任何决定，都会进入一个已经比营地更快运转的传信网。

signal.en: The nearest remounts cannot carry warning far tonight. The camp gains concealment, but the extra waiting consumes food.
signal.zh-Hans: 最近的换马今晚已无法把警讯送远。营地多了一层遮蔽，额外等待却要耗粮。

label.en: Offer the courier a place in the new network
label.zh-Hans: 让驿使加入新的传信网

intent.en: Convert an enemy channel instead of merely cutting it.
intent.zh-Hans: 不只截断敌方渠道，而是把它转为己用。

consequence.en: False calm moves east. Trusting him leaves a live weakness inside your plan.
consequence.zh-Hans: 虚假的平静向东传去；信任他，也让计划内部留下活的破绽。

strategy.en: Influence: alter what the opponent believes is possible.
strategy.zh-Hans: 影响之势：改变对手对局面的判断。

warning.en: A converted channel remains a channel the state can audit.
warning.zh-Hans: 被策反的渠道，仍是国家能够核查的渠道。

reveal.en: The false message passes, but the next post records the courier's missing seal. Deception creates time and a future question.
reveal.zh-Hans: 假消息顺利通过，下一亭却记下驿使缺少印验。欺骗争得了时间，也留下日后必问的问题。

label.en: Release the oldest conscripts before dawn

intent.en: Shrink the exposed column and let witnesses carry restraint home.
intent.zh-Hans: 缩小暴露的队伍，让见证者把克制带回乡里。

consequence.en: You lose hands today and gain doors that may open later.
consequence.zh-Hans: 今日少了人手，日后却可能多出愿意开启的家门。

strategy.en: Distributed strength: accept local weakness for a wider network.
strategy.zh-Hans: 散势：以局部减员换取更广的关系网。

warning.en: Released witnesses carry restraint—and the direction of travel.
warning.zh-Hans: 被放归的见证者既会传播克制，也会带走行军方向。

reveal.en: Families hear that the column kept its limit. A local clerk hears which road the released men took home.
reveal.zh-Hans: 乡里听说队伍守住了界线；一名乡吏也听说了放归者沿哪条路回家。

dateLabel.zh-Hans: 秦二世元年 · 第三日

context.en: The column reaches a damaged crossing. Scouts report patrols behind and uncertain towns ahead. Families, grain carts, and armed ranks cannot all cross at once. This is a recovery turn: reduce exposure, restore supplies, or preserve cohesion before the final commitment.
context.zh-Hans: 队伍来到一处被洪水毁坏的渡口。斥候报告追兵在后，前方城邑态度不明。家户、粮车与持械队伍无法同时过河。这是一轮整顿：在最终下注前，降低暴露、补充粮草，或维系队伍。

dialogue.en: You lay three tally slips on the wet rail: people, provisions, pursuit. The river will collect one kind of debt before sunset.
dialogue.zh-Hans: 你把三根筹片摆在湿漉漉的栏木上：人、粮、追兵。日落前，这条河必会来收一种债。

signal.en: The current is climbing against the stakes. Every crossing plan will lose provisions and leave the rear more exposed.
signal.zh-Hans: 水流正沿木桩上涨。无论采用哪种渡河方案，都会损失物资，也会让后队更加暴露。

signal.en: A small ferry brings hands and a little grain. It helps any plan—and adds witnesses who can describe the column.
signal.zh-Hans: 一只小缆渡带来人手和少量粮食。它能帮助任何方案，也多出一批能描述队伍的见证者。

intent.en: Make protection visible, even under pursuit.
intent.zh-Hans: 即使追兵迫近，也让保护成为可见的承诺。

consequence.en: The rear guard absorbs the risk; the movement gains a reason to survive.
consequence.zh-Hans: 后卫承担风险，而这支队伍获得了必须活下去的理由。

strategy.en: Moral center: cohesion can be operational power.
strategy.zh-Hans: 人心中枢：凝聚力也可以转化为行动力量。

warning.en: Protecting households fixes the column's pace under pursuit.
warning.zh-Hans: 追兵在后，保护家户也会锁定整支队伍的速度。

reveal.en: The rear guard holds formation long enough for the last household to cross. Patrol whistles are closer when it follows.
reveal.zh-Hans: 后卫维持队形，直到最后一户过河；等他们跟上时，巡卒的哨声已经更近。

label.en: Spend grain sacks to brace the ford

intent.en: Consume reserves to move everyone together.
intent.zh-Hans: 消耗储备，让所有人一同渡过。

consequence.en: The column crosses intact but hungry; pursuit loses time in the wreckage.
consequence.zh-Hans: 队伍完整却饥饿地过河；追兵在残桥处失去时间。

strategy.zh-Hans: 弃物保形：用物资换队形与时间。

warning.en: Visible labor and a repaired crossing leave evidence behind.
warning.zh-Hans: 公开劳作与修复后的渡口都会留下证据。

reveal.en: The braces hold, but wet grain and cut timbers mark exactly how the column crossed. Pursuit learns from the repair.
reveal.zh-Hans: 支架撑住了，湿粮与新砍的木料却清楚标出队伍如何过河。追兵从修复痕迹中读懂了路线。

label.en: Abandon the carts and scatter the tracks

intent.zh-Hans: 在包围合拢前夺回速度。

consequence.en: The pursuit guesses wrong, but hunger and resentment enter the ranks.
consequence.zh-Hans: 追兵判断失误，饥饿与怨气却进入队伍。

strategy.en: Light shape: mobility bought with future fragility.
strategy.zh-Hans: 轻势：以日后的脆弱换取眼下机动。

warning.en: Tracks can be scattered; abandonment cannot be hidden from those who owned the loads.
warning.zh-Hans: 车辙可以扰乱，弃下物资却瞒不过原先承担它的人。

reveal.en: The patrol follows the wrong bank. Three households turn back for what the carts carried, and resentment travels with them.
reveal.zh-Hans: 巡卒追向了错误的河岸；三户人家却为车上之物折返，怨气也随他们一同离去。

dateLabel.zh-Hans: 秦二世元年 · 陈县之南

context.en: Rumor multiplies: old Chu names in the southeast, an unusual circle of companions around Pei, frightened county seats nearby. The future victors are not yet inevitable. Your first campaign ends with a doctrine, not a coronation.
context.zh-Hans: 流言四起：东南有楚国旧族，沛县有一群不同寻常的伙伴，近处县城则惶恐不安。未来的胜者尚非必然。第一章以一种行动原则结束，而非加冕。

dialogue.en: Chen Sheng draws no map. He places three stones in the mud. “Power is not inside a stone. It is in what the ground lets the stones do to one another. Keeper—what ground will we make?”
dialogue.zh-Hans: 陈胜没有展开地图，只在泥里放下三块石头：“势不在石中，而在地形让石头彼此如何作用。掌简人——我们要造出怎样的地？”

signal.en: The nearest walls answer rumor with timber and crossbars. Any final doctrine loses tempo and becomes easier for officials to name as a threat.
signal.zh-Hans: 最近的城墙用木门与横闩回应流言。任何最终方略都会失去一些速度，也更容易被官吏称作威胁。

signal.en: Different travelers repeat the same account of restraint and defiance. Any doctrine gains belief and speed, while attention gathers with it.
signal.zh-Hans: 不同旅人都在复述同一段克制与反抗的故事。任何方略都会获得更多信任与速度，注意也会一同聚来。

label.en: Root the movement in village covenants

intent.en: Build food, messengers, and consent before claiming a realm.
intent.zh-Hans: 先建粮路、传信与同意，再谈天下。

consequence.en: Your network will grow slowly, and it may outlive its first banner.
consequence.zh-Hans: 你的网络会生长得慢，却可能比第一面旗帜活得更久。

strategy.en: Deep roots ending: durable legitimacy over immediate fame.
strategy.zh-Hans: 深根结局：以持久的合法性胜过眼前名声。

label.en: Race for Chen before fear hardens

intent.en: Turn a brief opening into a political fact.
intent.zh-Hans: 把短暂窗口变成既成政治事实。

consequence.en: The uprising becomes visible to the realm—and to every force capable of destroying it.
consequence.zh-Hans: 起事为天下所见，也被一切足以摧毁它的力量看见。

strategy.en: Wildfire ending: decisive initiative with a narrow supply base.
strategy.zh-Hans: 野火结局：以狭窄供给支撑决定性先手。

label.en: Send quiet envoys toward Pei and Kuaiji

intent.en: Learn the emerging board before joining one claimant.
intent.zh-Hans: 先看清新棋局，再决定与谁合流。

consequence.en: You surrender the loudest moment to gain information about two future centers of power.
consequence.zh-Hans: 你放弃最响亮的时刻，换取两个未来权力中心的情报。

strategy.en: Watchful strategist ending: options, intelligence, and delayed commitment.
strategy.zh-Hans: 观势结局：保留选择，以情报延迟下注。
